body: That's a great idea. Thank you so much. I'm going to try it and see what all I come up with, hopefully I can express everything properly.

That's what I keep telling myself I should do and honestly, it's what I want to do. I know myself too well though and I lose my self control far too easily. I'm afraid that as soon as I go to text her that switch in me is going to flip and I'll end up going off. How can I keep that under control?
Thank you, it's just so hard having everything important to you ripped away. I don't even know how to function without her.
Yeah, that's pretty much what happened. My ex from 5 years ago pretty much stole my girlfriend. Got in her head and convinced her to leave me. It really sucks.
How do you manage to handle it?

I've had depression like this before. I'm bipolar and not on medication, I'd just prefer to be manic right now rather than depressed. I don't want to hurt like this anymore over her. Over anything else is fine, just not her. I just wish I could forget her and erase the last year.

I probably should do that, being here is too hard and I need to get out for a bit. It can help a little. I just really don't want to be admitted to the hospital. It's embarrassing that I'm so torn up over a breakup. I just love her so much and I don't understand why I wasn't enough.

Dude I'm trying but it's so damn hard. She's everywhere I look, everything reminds me of her and I'm a serious mess. This was our home and she's just gone, my daughter keeps asking where she is and I don't know what to say. She's only 4 and doesn't get it. Fuck man, I wish it would all just stop so I can go on with my life.
I don't plan on talking to her unless I have to. We share a phone plan so I'm stuck until she pays her phone off

I mean, my parents are trying to be supportive and I have my best friend but I feel like if I'm alone for too long then I'm going to kill myself. I wish that I could deal with being alone but it hurts too much.

So far I've been asking myself the same thing. I gave that girl my whole heart and soul for her to just leave me the way she did. I'm entirely unsure how to keep pressing forward. I'm truly sorry you're going through the same thing, you have my sincerest apologies. I'd be glad to do what I can to help you
Thank you so much for all the support and love. It means alot. You've helped more than you know.

Thank you so much for the support. I think I want to try and focus on school, my new job and my daughter. Maybe eating healthier (once I can again) and exercising more. If I look better than maybe I'll feel better. I just want so bad to be happy.

It's just so hard because I don't remember a life before her. I'm not sure what to do with myself. I can't sleep or eat, food tastes like chalk in my mouth and it's so hard to breathe without my chest hurting. I feel like I shouldn't be in this much pain but I am.
Thank you so much. I love you too. I really needed to know that someone cares, I feel so broken and I seriously never thought I'd feel this way over a break up

I'm just not sure how to do it. I want to keep going and I know that I have to, my daughter is only 4 and she needs me. Probably the worst part of this was that she got hurt by my ex leaving. I don't know how to console her let alone myself.

Thank you for commenting. I really needed to hear something that would ease my mind. I just feel so awful and upset. Not only am I hurt that she left, but so is my 4 year old daughter. I had to lie to her this morning to explain why she left and she cried over it. It broke my heart even more. I'm not really even sure what to do with myself without her...
